ratings_why.fun: A clean climb: Tangle and Groomer seed the knot, Quorum turns on at Tier 4, and three real Tier 6 endings (pool, King, Piper) pull the build different ways.
ratings_why.distinct: Earns 8 over 7 because split damage changes how every fight resolves from Tier 1: no tribe today moves damage between units, and Gossip skims other tribes' gains.

verdict_why: The shape is ready; one keyword interaction under the split (Hunker) is unclear and worth a line before settling.

points.text: Tied says Hunker works only on the unit hit, but not whether it halves the whole hit before the split or only that unit's share. State which.
Supper Sniffer spreading Damage Reduction to a seven-unit knot makes any hit under 14 do almost nothing. Keep it hot, but have the owner test the risk's fallback rule early.
Golden Piper gives two free full-knot attacks before the enemy moves, which can end a fight outright. Worth a test against the pool build to see which ending wins.
Loyal Cagemate's Strays could land Tied into the gap the Cagemate leaves, so the text promises the knot stays joined rather than relying on nearest-slot placement.
Little Fips fades after Tier 2; a late hook, such as also counting Strays twice, would keep the edge rat on the board.

standouts.why: The Thirty-Two turns the knot into one body with one Health bar: a capstone you build the whole game toward.
The Piper flips the tribe's fear into a real late choice: grow tied, fight loose, with reading order as the puzzle.
The Bell-Ringer's vote is council comedy in play and gives Tier 4 its own job beside the Speaker.

weakest.why: Little Fips has no role past the early turns.
Ticklish Chirper is a smaller Gundel with little reason to keep once she arrives.
Knot of Ill Omen is situational and can spread your own small hits across their board.

flags.note: With Old Gundel, every share grows Attack on units that can't die until the pool drains; bounded by fight length but worth the runaway check.
Damage Reduction copied across a big knot applies to every share and can blank most hits.
Golden Ilse makes every Gossip gain all of the knot's growth; with two Gossips and Speaker at Quorum 7 that is a large multiplier, though not a loop.
Golden Piper's two free volleys before the enemy acts may decide fights at Start of Combat.
